answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a glacier bet on surviving 58 epochs of grading, and every ripple settlement recomputes the fable schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 58 epochs rather than arriving at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
